_note: flight-software (FSW) local numbers, owner F4, revision F4-R11 (2026-11-14, D-174: 80 A, 2.70 kg, LiHV Shorty, THR_MAX 41. R10 D-173: X2814 V3 + 11x8E/EP, Q_M_SPIN_MAX 0.81, limiter 75 A, THR_MAX 42 + FWD_BAT compensation; D-173b CoreWing, Lua withdrawn. R9: CR-F5-15/16, BATT_LOW 3 000; R8: CR-C1-40, CR-B4-31, B3 entry design, E2 / H2-4, D-161; R7 design round D-145..D-157; R6 2026-11-13). The parameter file K09L.param is the source; each key below mirrors one line of it (key ap = ArduPilot name) so proof-chain claims can read it. team/F4/fsw_check.py fails if a value here differs from K09L.param. Motor map: SPEC.md section 'Motor and output map'.

firmware.value: ArduPlane 4.7.2 stable or later, target CoreWingF405WingV2 (D-33, D-173b; board support entered ArduPilot in 4.7.2; no Lua)

airspeed_cruise_ms.note: was 16.0 = P:performance.cruise_ms. B6: the tripped stall 12.85 m/s is the planning baseline until T-B2-STALL, so AIRSPEED_MIN = CRUISE = 17. performance.cruise_ms stays 16 until S2 / A1 move the power models (D-122)

airspeed_min_ms.source: review/CDR-2026-11-13/CDR-SUMMARY.md decision B6 (D-122): ceil(1.3 x CL-B2R3-VS-GATE-FWD-TURB 12.85 = 16.71)
airspeed_min_ms.note: was 16 (D-36, D-71). Integer parameter (AP_Int16). 17 holds for a measured trimmed stall <= 13.07 m/s. After T-B2-STALL set ceil(1.3 x measured): <= 12.31 -> 16; 13.07-13.85 -> second fallback 18 with AIRSPEED_MAX 20 (CL-B2R3-FB2-*, PROPOSED)

spin_max.note: F4-R10: fixed 0.81 (one motor at full output, fresh pack: 49.3 A winding <= 50, 40.0 A ESC <= 45); R9 0.746 + Lua schedule withdrawn (D-173b)

thr_max_pct.note: F4-R11: 42 -> 41 for the 17.4 V LiHV pack (0.41 <= 0.414 for VH at 2.70 kg); FWD_BAT_VOLT_MAX / MIN scale it as the pack sags

bat_curr_max_a.note: F4-R11: 75 -> 80 (D-174). Valid only after T-F1-SENSOR-CAL +/-1.1 % at 70-80 A

pilot_spd_dn_ms.note: R5: 1.2 -> 1.0 m/s; full down stick in QHOVER/QLOITER is the design hard landing (CL-F4-TOUCHDOWN-SINK)

notch_harmonics.note: highest harmonic in INS_HNTCH_HMNCS 3 (bits 1, 2). F4-R8: 3P is above the gyro Nyquist with the uncapped E props

batt_low_mah.note: F4-R11: E2 D-173 Shorty value (A1 D-174); R10 3 200 (Ovonic)

batt_fs_low_act.source: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/B3.md section 2 path 3; H2-4b; F4.md section 4
batt_fs_low_act.note: F4-R8: 1 RTL -> 6 Loiter to QLand: from a Q mode straight to QLAND (no forward transition)

fence_action.note: 1 = RTL; Plane has no Q-mode fence action. Hover breach = bounded double fault (CL-B3-TRANS-PITCH-USE-HOVERTHR)

batt_capacity_mah.note: PLACEHOLDER = 0.92 x P:battery.capacity_ah 6.0 (pack acceptance floor). Before flight: the lowest measured T-E2-CAPACITY of the packs flown

batt_arm_volt_v.source: F4.md D-174 (LiHV 4.25 V/cell, EST; E2 to confirm)

motor_map.note: hover copter frame: forward = belly (-z), right = +y; ArduPilot Quad X: M1 front-right CCW, M2 back-left CCW, M3 front-left CW, M4 back-right CW (viewed from above in hover = from the nose). UNVERIFIED until the props-off motor test (T-F4-BENCH-MAP). adapter_thread: LH on the CW motors so prop drag tightens the nut (CR-E1-21). cant_print: the mount print each station needs with the prints as D3 defines them today (print A gives UR thrust a side component along +t = x_hat x r_hat); the map needs UR along -t, so UR and LL take print B (CR-F4-11)

tecs_sink_max_ms.source: F4 choice: inside the 10 deg pitch floor

rate_p.note: ArduPilot rate PID: output (-1..1) per rad/s of rate error

wvane_land.note: 1 = nose (copter nose = belly, -z) into wind; was 3 side (wingtip). Never 2 or 4 (pod face to the wind)

wvane_takeoff.note: 1 = nose (copter nose = belly, -z) into wind; was 3 side (wingtip). AUTO VTOL take-offs only. Never 2 or 4 (pod face to the wind)

fltmodes.source: team/F5 CR-F5-15 (slot order); team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md R-SPIRAL (D-66): roll-stabilised modes only
fltmodes.note: QSTABILIZE, FBWA, CRUISE, QHOVER, RTL, QLOITER (F4-R9; was 17, 18, 19, 5, 7, 11)

spin_min.source: ArduPilot default, stated (CALC-F4-VLEVEL input); stand sets it (TUNING-PLAN step 2)

q_rtl_mode.source: review/NASA-CR-132423-COMPLIANCE.md C-01, G-01 (CR-132423 p. 35, 38-39, 172); ArduPilot master value 2 = VTOL approach, read 2026-11-13
q_rtl_mode.note: was 1; circle down to Q_RTL_ALT, back-transition into the wind, QRTL. UNVERIFIED on 4.7.x and on a tailsitter: SITL S1, S18

q_rtl_alt_m.note: was 30; mode 2 transitions at this height

q_fw_lnd_apr_rad_m.note: bank atan(16^2/(9.81 x 60)) = 23.5 deg at 16 m/s, inside Table 29 9-30 deg (EST)

q_trans_decel_ms2.source: ArduPilot default, stated (master, read 2026-11-13); review/NASA-CR-132423-COMPLIANCE.md C-04, G-07 (CR-132423 p. 19 Eq. (1))
q_trans_decel_ms2.note: stopping distance 16^2 / (2 x 2.0) = 64 m (EST); SITL S18 logs the real overshoot

elevon_pwm_left_us.source: CALC-F4-ELEVON-PWM from CL-D6-THROW-NEED / CALC-D6-KIN (CR-D6-09); replace from T-D6-THROW
elevon_pwm_left_us.note: MIN, TRIM, MAX, REVERSED (last entry 0/1, not us)

mixing_gain.note: was 0.5 (firmware default). Pure pitch reaches 0.65 x 25 = 16.25 deg; full pitch leaves 8.75 deg of roll. B3's forward CG limit (CL-B3-V-CG-FWD) now reads this key instead of requirements.elevon_trim_travel_max; that key (0.5) still limits the trim at 1.3 Vs (R-CRUISE-AUTHORITY)

yaw_acc_max_degs2.note: new. The 4.6 name Q_A_ACCEL_Y_MAX (cdeg/s/s, 13 500) is Q_A_ACC_Y_MAX in deg/s/s on 4.7 (range 0-720, pdef stable-4.7.1; ReleaseNotes PR 32192). CL-F4-YAW-ACC-SET

rc_fs_timeout_s.source: ArduPlane 4.7 default, stated (D-124); RC_Channels_VarInfo.h tag Plane-4.7.2
rc_fs_timeout_s.note: new. Replaces FS_SHORT_TIMEOUT, which 4.7 removed (ReleaseNotes PR 30350). RC loss in a Q mode -> QLAND at this time (events.cpp rc_failsafe_short_on_event); SITL 2026-11-13: 1.15 s

fs_long_timeout_s.note: fixed-wing modes: CIRCLE -> RTL after 5 s. Not the Q-mode QLAND timer (D-124)

assist_speed_ms.note: 1.08 x the tripped forward-CG stall 12.94 (B1 2026-11-14); ArduPilot guidance AIRSPEED_MIN - 3 = 14. Unchanged in F4-R7

assist_alt_m.note: F4-R8: 15 -> 0 (off): motors-only assist runs the copter rate loop (120 deg/s), bypassing the 35 deg/s FW clamp. B4 withdrew CR-B4-31 (rpm). Change K09L.param and this key together

transition_ms.note: inert while Q_TAILSIT_RAT_FW is configured; derived rate 70 / (11667/2000) = 12.0 deg/s

angle_boost.source: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/B3.md section 1.2; tailsitter.cpp / AC_AttitudeControl.cpp tag Plane-4.7.2
angle_boost.note: must be set: the tailsitter defaults table (0) applies only to Q_FRAME_CLASS 10; the Quad-class default is 1

tailsit_ang_vt_deg.source: ArduPilot default, stated (B3 closure 1.4): 0 = use Q_TAILSIT_ANGLE

q_options.note: bit 5 off (RC loss in a Q mode -> QLAND), bit 16 off (VTOL approach used by Q_RTL_MODE 2), bit 20 off

ins_pos_m.source: CALC-F4-SENSOR-POS (CR-F3-20 IMU point, D-62 CG x 0.0490, z 0.0185)
ins_pos_m.note: FRD from the CG; INS_POS2 the same (CoreWing, D-173b)

gps_pos_m.source: CALC-F4-SENSOR-POS (CR-F3-20 GPS centre, D-62 CG x 0.0490, z 0.0185)
gps_pos_m.note: FRD from the CG; re-measure as built
